Beside him, an older man in a light beige suit and polo shirt also holds multiple microphones. They are positioned centrally, facing forward toward a bank of cameras not seen in the frame. (2) The scene cuts to a montage of past media appearances. Ethan is seen in a black t-shirt talking to a man in a white polo in a home-like setting, then in a formal suit in an office-like environment. He is consistently shown with microphones near his face, indicating his career as a reporter. The lighting in these clips is generally bright, capturing various indoor professional and domestic settings. (3) A quick succession of lifestyle shots shows Ethan in different roles. He leans against a rustic wooden wall with his eyes closed, suggesting exhaustion or reflection. Then, he is seen being interviewed in a red suit jacket on a stage with a band behind him. Another clip shows him in a hair salon, draped in a colorful cape, looking at a script while a stylist works on his hair, highlighting the behind-the-scenes nature of his work. (4) Ethan sits at a podcast table with three other people in a professional studio equipped with large condenser microphones and acoustic treatment on the walls. He wears a yellow t-shirt and laughs during a lively conversation. Later, he is seen in a large, modern event hall sitting among an audience, then standing on a stage with a large promotional screen. He gestures and interacts with students in a classroom filled with camera equipment and lockers, conveying a sense of mentorship and return to his educational roots.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a career retrospective and a promotional announcement by media personality Ethan Kuan Kuan. He shares his journey from an unmotivated high school student to a successful television reporter, crediting Shih Hsin University and SET TV for his growth. The narrative concludes by promoting a new collaborative dating show and encouraging current students to follow their passions.
